title: Engineering Auditor Review Usefulness Sheet v1
description: Usefulness scores for one engineering review (`review rubric` writes it unscored): one item per answered claim and recommendation, each scored correct, specific, actionable, and by its novelty against the report (restates a finding, adds detail that follows from the report and the code, or goes beyond what the report can say); an item is useful when it is correct, specific, and actionable and does not merely restate a finding. A model's score is a pre_label until a second, different model agrees (corroborated) or a person scores it (final); a disagreeing check is a dispute only a person settles. Only corroborated and final items count. No scoring model may be one the review ran on.

review_digest.description: The scored review record's canonical-JSON digest.

novelty.description: restates: a finding or its own recommendation says it already; adds_detail: detail that follows from the report and a look at the code, such as where and how to apply the report's own fix or its facts assembled; beyond_report: what the report cannot say (why a finding exists or how much it matters, a better fix than the report's, which findings are benign).
